detection_proxy_file_level.note: File-level proxy only; not span-level precision/recall/F1. Use as a reproducible baseline until span-labelled comparative harness is complete.

limitations: Synthetic MineSweep-owned corpus only; no CredDetX integration or pinned gitleaks/TruffleHog comparison yet.
Metrics are file-level proxies, not span-level P/R/F1.
Real-repository corpus and injected-canary evaluation are not included.
Results should not be presented as proof of superiority over other scanners.
